content:
Maria: Heads up — VegaHealth QBR next Tue. Onboarding still ~60% (SSO + docs incomplete). Their token burn spiked ~3x in the last 48h. Need a short playbook + a spend forecast for the QBR. Who can own the spend narrative and a 1-slide ask?

cost-bot: ALERT: account=VegaHealth spend spike 3.2x vs baseline (48h). top_routes=embeddings-encode, chat-stream. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/vegahealth/spend

Leo: I can run numbers. Baseline monthly looks ~ $12k, current projection w/ spike ~ $38k. I will produce a 30/60/90 day forecast by tomorrow EOD. Want route+model+region breakdown?

Maria: Route + model level would be ideal. Also please include a "cost per 1k tokens" breakdown for their top 3 flows.

Priya: Quick scan of their token distribution: heavy embeddings QPS (many small vectors). Suggest batching + local KV caching for prefixes. Also have a quantization rec that reduces token compute cost ~15% on their main model.

Jordan: On enablement — I have a 20-min playbook demo ready (prefix caching + autoscale tweaks + quick dashboard tips). Can run a pre-QBR session for their PM/engs. Need a 1-slide "asks" (credits vs rate-limits).

Ashley: I will own the renewal risk narrative. Need latest health score + top blockers (SSO, docs). Can someone pull health score + last NPS note and drop here?

Maria: Action items: Leo = forecast + cost breakdown CSV, Priya = optimization recs + config snippets, Jordan = enablement demo + ask slide, Ashley = renewal narrative + health score. I'll assemble the QBR deck. Timeline: drafts by Friday COB.

Leo: Will post forecast CSV here when ready. Using 3 scenarios: conservative/expected/aggressive. Example header I will publish:
```
date,conservative,expected,aggressive
2026-04-01,12000,38000,52000
```
Attaching route-level sheet next.

cost-bot: NOTE: budget-alert threshold=75% of committed credits triggered. Flagging for CS follow-up and billing watch.

Priya: Optimization snippet for the engs to test quickly:
```
# embed batching suggestion (pseudo)
payload = {
  "batch_size": 16,
  "cache_window_ms": 30000
}
```
Also will attach a mini eval comparing quantized vs fp16 latencies.

Jordan: Scheduled pre-QBR enablement for Tue 09:30 PT with VegaHealth PM/eng. Zoom link shared in calendar invite. I'll drop the invite to their AWS SSO admin too.

Ashley: Pulled health score = 62. Last NPS comment: "docs confusing for advanced embeddings flow; onboarding unclear." Saving the verbatim feedback for the slide.

Maria: :thumbsup: Good progress. One more ask — include a safe rollback plan for any throttles (A/B, canary). We must avoid breaking onboarding flow.

Leo: Will include rollback: fallback to cached responses + canary 10% rollout plan and monitoring thresholds (error rate + latency).

Maria: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. I'll start building the QBR deck and wire up the slides.

Maria: (closing) Done for now.
